purpose: Behavioral reference for native-engine prototypes; not a requirement to reproduce browser implementation details.
matterInvariants: authoritative matter, render surface, and rigid-body physics proxy are separate concerns
precision edits target authoritative matter rather than the coarse rigid-body proxy
chunks or bricks are spatial/render partitions, not physical owners
detachment and ownership transfer do not create resource rewards
static-to-dynamic transfer is atomic: no duplicated or lost physical matter
detached MatterActors own resolved local matter and remain recursively destructible
material behavior dispatches from authoritative hit material
unknown structural support fails closed rather than causing speculative collapse
procedural source matter does not regenerate after accepted runtime removal or extraction

knownRepresentationLimitation: One diagnostic scalar-derived material label drifted from immutable parcel material in Phase E. Parcel identity/material remained authoritative for transfer, ledger and targeting. The native representation should try to remove this ambiguity rather than depend on it.
nativePortGuidance: use these values as reference evidence, not performance targets
do not reproduce the fixed 3x3 browser storage model merely to match the fixture
do not reproduce DOM/mobile/browser input or packaging systems
native prototypes may use different physics and meshing implementations while preserving the behavioral invariants
